name: Analytical Line Integrals of 3D Anisotropic Gabor Kernel
aliases: Closed-form definite line integrals for Gabor kernel
Closed-form definite line integrals for projected 3D anisotropic Gabor kernel
definition: A method to compute the exact line integral of a 3D anisotropic Gabor kernel along an arbitrary ray segment, avoiding numerical integration errors.
summary: This method computes the exact line integral of a 3D anisotropic Gabor kernel along a ray segment, avoiding numerical sampling errors and enabling distance sampling for multiple scattering.
